title: Task dossier view
description: Body of a `report` artifact: a board task's dossier as one reader is given it, at one entry (docs/design/task-dossier.md, ADR-0070). A step's brief points at a slice (a summary and the latest entries within `maxChars`, progressive disclosure); a run's workspace is given the whole dossier as `.system/DOSSIER.md`, within its own bound. Rendered by the engine from the entries it names, never by a model.

entries.description: How many entries the dossier holds at `head`.

head.description: The latest entry: the dossier this view is of.

shown.description: The entries whose text the view holds, oldest first.

maxChars.description: The bound `text` was rendered within, in characters (code points).
